scientific_integrity: The finite assertions rest on an exhaustive exact-arithmetic Prüfer enumeration, a complete tree-isomorphism canonical code, and polynomial nonnegativity certificates, accompanied by a fully reconstructible checker. Neither empirical validity nor independent validation is asserted. A previously published reliability analysis shows analogous edge-importance switches on cyclic two-terminal networks, so this work claims only its sharp tree-specific classification.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers only finite undirected trees of order 2 through 8, one preemptively removed edge, uniform random seed, independent equal-probability bond transmissions, and expected final outbreak size; it makes no statement about larger graphs, empirical infections, heterogeneous or dependent transmissions, or multi-edge cuts.
title: First transmissibility-sensitive optimal edge cuts in tree epidemics
